{{Quote|I got what I thought was a deal on this ship.|Bosbit Matarcher, on his malfunctioning Delemedian starhopper|<ref name="SWHNN48" />}}
A '''Delemedian starhopper''' was a type of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump drive]]&ndash;equipped [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was in existence by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[212 BBY]]. One starhopper belonged to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bosbit Matarcher]], who experienced [[Time travel/Legends|time dilation]] due to faulty [[relativistic shield]]ing upon using the starhopper's jump drive. When Matarcher emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Delemedian starhopper was considered an antique.

==Description==
A type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the Delemedian starhopper required a crew of at least one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and was equipped with both [[relativistic shield]]ing and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump drive]].<ref name="SWHNN48" />

==Role==
The Delemedian starhopper could be used for [[Star system/Legends|intersystem]] travel.<ref name="SWHNN48" />

==History==
{{Quote|I engaged the jump drive for a trip in outsystem. It took about two hours. When I got out, it was 200 years later.|Bosbit Matarcher, regarding his Delemedian starhopper|<ref name="SWHNN48" />}}
Delemedian starhoppers were a type of starship in use during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWHNN48" /> In [[212 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> [[Bosbit Matarcher]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from<ref name="SWHNN48" /> the astronomical object<ref name="On Both Their Houses">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|On Both Their Houses}}</ref> [[Delemede/Legends|Delemede]], purchased on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] a starhopper that had malfunctioning relativistic [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]]. Matarcher thought he got a good price on the ship, but when he activated the starhopper's jump drive and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to leave his [[Delemede system/Legends|home system]], the faulty relatavistic shielding left the ship and everything aboard subject to [[Time travel/Legends|time dilation]], in which the ship experienced [[Time/Legends|time]] at a slower rate than the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The starhopper, with Matarcher still alive onboard, did not exit hyperspace until<ref name="SWHNN48" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> while he only experienced a two-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] trip. By that time, the starhopper was considered an antique. Matarcher's starhopper was mentioned in a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] article about Matarcher<ref name="SWHNN48" /> on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:3:21, in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Dates" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delemedian starhopper was first mentioned in "225-year Old Man's Secret? Time Dilation" an article<ref name="SWHNN48" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #48]] on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="SWHNN48" /> on [[March 21]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN48 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6128630|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=PrinceXizor|date=2002-03-21|time=3:24 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref>
